issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The diff reads no files, uses no network, pastes no coordinates and does not touch the harness. All randomness comes from the seeded rng. Every result still goes through the existing _repair step, so the exact validity check still applies.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The kick types are chosen in proportion to (wins+1)/(tries+3), which always sums to a positive number. kind=-1 marks the first random start and is kept out of the counts. The swap kick handles the case where no pair of circles differs in radius by more than 0.01. Both shrunk radii stay non-negative. Clipping and the repair step keep the output valid. The timing loop is unchanged.

Recomputed z from the rounded numbers: (2.6354 - 2.6349) / (0.0023 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/2)) ≈ 0.18. The harness reports 0.202. The gap fits rounding of the run values shown (it would need a difference of about 0.00057 instead of 0.0005), so it is not a real mismatch.

The candidate has only 1 run, and its gain of about 0.0005 is far smaller than the noise sd of 0.0023. The reject decision is consistent with the numbers. The new kick logic adds moderate complexity for a gain that has not been shown, so rejecting it fits the simplicity rule.
